result.title: PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
result.summary: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于物理信息的自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架用于 EEG 扩展源成像，不依赖配对源标签或仿真预训练，以 lead field 约束 INR，将皮层电流密度建模为连续坐标条件场，并用经典逆解做热启动与空间约束。
AI.relevance_reason: 连续坐标条件的 INR 作为承载空间细节与范围的隐式状态，以及用前向测量一致性替代标签的自监督约束，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的空间表示与 latent 状态一致性监督提供概念线索，尚需核查其与 VLM 内部表示的关联。
